correctness.rationale: Reading actual AIMS Mathematics (2026) PDF section 3.2 and Appendix B4 confirms its printed CKD-only equations Sdot=Lambda-(lambda_k+mu)S; Ikdot=lambda_k S+gamma_h H-phi Ik; Hdot=zeta_k Ik-psi H, phi=zeta_k+mu_k+mu, psi=gamma_h+mu_h+mu. Set D=phi*psi-gamma_h*zeta_k=zeta_k(mu_h+mu)+(mu_k+mu)(gamma_h+mu_h+mu)>0 for all positive death/outflow rates. Then S*=Lambda/(lambda_k+mu), I*=lambda_k Lambda psi/[(lambda_k+mu)D]>0 and H*=zeta_k I*/psi>0 for EVERY positive lambda_k. The EXACT affine Jacobian has characteristic polynomial (r+lambda_k+mu)(r^2+(phi+psi)r+D), hence all eigenvalues have negative real parts for all lambda_k>=0 and the unique equilibrium attracts globally exponentially. I* increases continuously with lambda_k, with I*(0)=0; no positive-hazard exchange of equilibrium branches. Original Ck=1 corresponds to positive lambda*=mu D/[Lambda(psi+zeta_k)], not a zero eigenvalue; the printed Appendix B4 assertion of such an eigenvalue and transcritical bifurcation cannot hold. A separate symbolic differentiation and residual check reproduced the matrix and fixed point exactly.
